sourceBinding: 运行时使用当前工作树，文件哈希另由交付记录绑定

checks.label: evidence-paths
checks.command: pnpm -C packages/conformance exec tsx -e (async()=>{const fs=await import("node:fs");const path=await import("node:path");const assert=await import("node:assert/strict");const d=await import("./src/delivery-recovery.fixture.ts");const o=await import("./src/optional-domains.fixture.ts");assert.equal(o.optionalEvidenceRoot,path.resolve(process.env.WORKMESH_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE_ROOT));d.saveDeliveryEvidence("docs-probe.json",{probe:true});o.saveOptionalEvidence("docs-probe.json",{probe:true});for(const root of [process.env.WORKMESH_DELIVERY_EVIDENCE_ROOT,process.env.WORKMESH_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE_ROOT])assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,"docs-probe.json"),"utf8")).probe,true);console.log("owned evidence output paths verified")})()
